text: Hello, boys and girls.I'm Yvonne.Welcome to my English class.Today, we'll go on learning the writing section in UNIS3.And these are what you are expected to learn in today's lesson.Please get your textbook and worksheet ready.We have learned the post diary.So, do you remember what a diary is?Yes, a diary is a book in which we write down the experiences we have each day, our feelings and private thoughts, etc.What do people usually write in their diaries?We usually write something special, meaningful and unusual in our diaries.What tense do people usually use when keeping a diary?Yes, the simple past tense, because we use the simple past tense to describe the events happened in the past.Now you are Judy.You keep a diary every day.Yesterday was your birthday, and you saw a robbery.What will you write in your diary?You may write something about the birthday, because it is a special day to you.What's more, you must write something about the robbery, because it is an unusual event in your life.Let's look at these six pictures which were taken on Judy's birthday.Please think about what the first three pictures were about.Right, they were about Judy's birthday.In what order was the story told?We can notice the time on each picture.Obviously, it was told in time order.What about the other pictures?What were they about?Yes, they were about a bank robbery happened on Judy's birthday.Yes, you've got it.It was told in sequence of an event.That means 事件的發展順序If a story is told in time order or in sequence of an event, it will be more logical and well-organized.Now let's look at the first picture.Who came in the morning?Yes, he is a postman.What did he give to Judy?Some letters and birthday cards.It was Judy's birthday.Perhaps these letters and cards were from her relatives and friends.When did he give the letters and cards to Judy?Yes, at 10 a.Where were they?Maybe at the front door of Judy's house.How did Judy feel?She felt happy and surprised because we can see the big smile on her face.Now can you use this information and make up the sentences to describe the picture?Well done.We can say At 10 a., a postman came to Judy's house and gave her some letters and birthday cards.She felt happy and surprised.Pay attention.We should write in the first person.We should change Judy's name.We should change Judy's to mine, her to me, and she to I.Remember, when we are describing an event, we can use WH questions and how questions to gather details.Now suppose you were Judy.What did you hear when the postman came?I heard knocks on the door.What did you think when you heard the knocks?I may think who would come?What would the postman say to Judy?Perhaps he would say, Good morning, girl.Here are some letters and cards for you.Happy birthday.And Judy would reply, Thank you.So we can add the sensory details and dialogues to make a diary more vivid.This is my idea.Today was my birthday.At 10am, I heard some knocks on the door.Who is that?I wondered.To my surprise, a postman came and gave me some letters and birthday cards.He said, Happy birthday to you.I was glad to receive so many letters and cards.Now, please look at the second picture.Can you complete the table according to it?Happy birthday to you.I think all of you can get the answers.Let's check.So we can make up the sentences likeAt 1pm, my parents, my brother and I had lunch at Thai Palace.We were pleased.I think the sentences are not vivid enough.Can you make them more attractive?You can add different details in it.It's Thai style.It's task one on your worksheet.Ben, can you share your idea?At 1pm, my parents, my brother and I went to Thai Palace for lunch to celebrate my birthday.The food was so delicious that we enjoyed it very much.Well done, Ben.Alice, what about your idea?At 1pm, my family celebrated my birthday at Thai Palace.How delicious the food is, said my brother happily.My father said to me, help yourself to some fish.I felt warm and happy to have my family around me on my birthday.Good job, Alice.We can see Alice added sensory details and dialogues in her writing, right?That makes the writing more impressive.Now class, it's your turn to describe the pictures.When describing the pictures, pay attention to these WH questions and how questions, which will help you to gather details.And in order to make your writing more vivid, you can add sensory details and dialogues.Please take out your worksheet.It's task two.中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶Daisy, can you share yours?, we
